releases.title: OpenAI identities per environment, Brain 4.0 coaching score structure, cost meter, analysis engine page, Liquid Glass look and owner Home/Leads/Settings slices, CI prerequisites cache
Lead pipelines (migration 0121), dialler call recordings join their lead call (Xiaomi), Home funnel per pipeline
Lead stages by kind of business, guided lead ads setup with Meta review status
Home starts with sales, Chats redesign, Settings Selling, swipe asks before calling, Save says what it needs
Leads on one page with stage tabs and a Start calling bar, how lead stages work, sales performance API for the new Home
Phone UX: Back closes every sheet and overlay, Add (lead or call) on the + button, names with capitals, All leads fits the phone
Production fast call-data runner reads only calls that one pass does not fill (short-call and data-only calls)
AI on calls per seller with the short-call rule (transcript and lead details for calls under a minute), salesperson profile, CRM lead delete
Gemini one-pass output trim and calibration, Brain 4.0 blind review and gold checkpoints (migration 0118), Luna hybrid (sealed later, off)
Brain 4.0 beta shadow reads (migration 0117, off until raised), Luna route for one pass (inert until sealed), AI spend cap and checkpoint reset scripts
One-pass Flex production switch script (AUT-2177), one pass B1-B3 (inert until sealed), Brain 4.0 beta, Dependabot no longer blocks releases
Gemini Flex for call analysis (fallback to standard), Next 16.3.8, sharp and shell-quote security bumps
One-pass transcription for long calls, Pillow 13 and certifi security bumps
One-pass analysis with Gemini Flash-Lite transcription (owner switch, classic fallback), OpenAI as a call-analysis processor, USD-INR reference rates and pseudonymous usage export, CI runners pinned

Lead stages, AI spend caps and guard, Chats inbox with read marks, Lead Desk Messenger/Instagram/WhatsApp and AI replies (off), Settings revamp and Developers page, design system v2, faster calls list, MCP sign-in discovery fix

Report and budget settings, Review 2.0, developer platform (API keys, webhooks, Connect), Lead Desk Meta conversions, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, ad spend and AI replies (off), Admin 2.0 settings and staff keys, sign-in with Google redirect and account linking safeguards, call-data and playback fixes
Review routes never hold a database connection (fix for the 19 Oct production pool exhaustion)
Phone fixes for the Android app: signed-out welcome, compact Leads with WhatsApp and SMS, one-step call flow, permissions one at a time, policy pages fixed

Call data engine (fast and deep pipelines, call facts, Admin call map); Wise Life partner webhooks (off until set up); Prospect reads engine facts; smoother loading; Admin workspaces and environment switch
Phone alerts for new gold reviews; calls that run out of AI budget wait and continue by themselves; one-click budget raises in Admin; budget alerts
Admin: usage and cost for every environment; AI budget holds settle automatically; an analysis start survives a brief outage

Prospect gets its own tab (Report | Prospect | Coaching): who the buyer is, need/budget/authority/timing with quotes, what to remember before the next call; phone setup shows where your phone saves recordings
Gold review on the phone for reviewers
Download page for the apps (salesxray.authorityclosers.com/apps: Android button, QR, version and checksum, install help); calls are never left as Untitled call
Upload and report fixes from the owner test: the details step keeps your answers, clearer pointer wording, no more Untitled call, better speaker guess; Google Ads settings wiring
Leads: Google Ads lead connector (Continue with Google; stays off until its settings are added)

Leads: log work calls from the phone, after-call sheet, phone setup checklist, work hours, Call back, calls report and CSV, Save as lead, Mark private; phone app download on; updated consent asks once
Minutes are used only when a report is ready: a call that fails, is cancelled or expires before its report gives its minutes back
Upload terms name the AI providers and calls are kept until deleted; Leads: Taking new leads switch, Someday follow-up, Last call in short; six UI fixes
Database backups: the logical Postgres dump may be up to 64 MiB (was 8 MiB), so the scheduled production backups run again
